notes: Two corrections. (1) The waw s009 was `unrepresented` with even unto given whole to עַד; it now takes *even* and עַד takes *unto*. Rule 16's even unto expansion carries an express limit where a connective morpheme stands in the clause, and rule 14 itself aligns the waw of וָיָמָּה to the *even* of *even unto the sea*; rule 26 counts a מִן … עַד range's connective morphemes against the ASV's connectives, and here two English words answer to two morphemes. The competing reading is recorded on both units.

(2) The supplied *to* before Seir was inside the participle's unit under rule 44; it now belongs to שֵׂעִיר under rule 33. עָלָה is intransitive and Seir is an accusative of direction, not a bare direct object, which is the boundary rule 44 draws in its own closing limit (*to your mountain*).
Everything else stands: 31 source morphemes and 34 target tokens are each used once; the margin's *Or, the bare mountain* was read and set aside (rule 38).
